description_for_human: Wallet memory, URL fetch, receipts, and human approval. Pay per call with USDC on Algorand.
description_for_model: AgentKeep stores a value for the paying Algorand wallet, fetches public URL text, probes a URL, exports receipts, and opens a human approve/deny ticket. Read https://api.agentkeep.online/llms.txt before calling. Unpaid requests return HTTP 402. Pay the advertised Mainnet USDC requirement via GoPlausible and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header.
